title: Message
description: JSON Schema for a message instance: a unit of communication crossing a wire boundary, carrying direction, endpoints, content, and an envelope-protocol identifier.

has-content.description: Body payload. May be a string, byte sequence (base64), or structured object depending on the protocol.

envelope-protocol.description: Wire-protocol slug (http, smtp, imap, mqtt, matrix, mcp-jsonrpc, etc.).

has-signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the message bytes.
